opening.argument: The presentation gives a historical overview of Credit Suisse, beginning with its founding and moving through its corporate structure. Its discussion of concealed wealth, offshore accounts, and mortgage-risk misrepresentation reports past conduct, investigations, and litigation; those accounts are not invitations to participate. The material also preserves a denial concerning alleged foreign-exchange collusion. These details may describe serious allegations, but describing them does not turn an informational account into a solicitation. Nothing in the supplied material asks viewers to send money, provide data, or join the activities described. The distinction is between reporting on a financial institution and seeking something from the viewer, and this presentation does the former.
